animationHypothesis.claim: The three low scores were caused by continuously animating media that the harness did not freeze, not by a structural or visual mismatch.
evidence: The unfrozen capture is not reproducible: showreel / studio strip / notes index scored 0.6249 / 0.6704 / 0.7954 in the 1.1.0 record, [0.6318, 0.5793, 0.7969] in re-run 1 and [0.7094, 0.6013, 0.8055] in re-run 2 of the unchanged capture.
With the symmetric freeze the same sections score [0.9964, 0.9994, 0.994] (official) and [0.9966, 0.9994, 0.994] (repeat); no section of the 53 differs between the two full runs by more than 0.0038.

The score moves with animation phase when only the phase differs: with the clone deliberately 1000 ms / 2500 ms out of phase the scores fall to showreel 0.8097 / 0.6639, studio strip 0.5986 / 0.4927, notes index 0.7773 / 0.6721; with both sides frozen at the same non-zero phase (1000 ms / 2500 ms) they stay at showreel 0.9961 / 0.9795, studio strip 0.9538 / 0.9382, notes index 0.9368 / 0.9654.

Static geometry matches (see geometry): every live media rect inside the viewport has a clone rect at IoU >= 0.8 with median edge delta 0 px, and text rows match one to one except a few rows the live page renders that the clone does not; for the strip, all 3 live item boxes that reach the 1440 px viewport match a clone box (the 4th live item box sits off-screen left because its ticker keeps a wrapped item there; the clone renders 12 boxes = 3 copies, the extra ones lie off-screen right). Motion speeds match: measured track velocities are about 98 px/s on both sides for the reel bands and the strip, and about 49 / 73 / 24 px/s on both sides for the three feed columns.

Diagnosed from live / clone / diff images (local scratch, not committed): the unfrozen diffs are the shifted strip, shifted headline bands and shifted feed cards; the frozen captures show the same frame, the same image placement and the same text.
harnessArtefactsFoundAndFixed: a freeze that only set the track transform to 0 left the live site's wrap-style ticker (it moves items that left the view to the far end with per-item offsets) with a blank first item and scored the strip 0.26 on some runs; fixed by aligning the first item with the track start edge and releasing / re-pinning at every shot
lazy-loaded live images enter the view only after the pin: the freeze now waits for visible images to have pixels

geometry.note: text-free box matching taken from the frozen 1.1.2 captures; media = img/video/canvas/background-image boxes (IoU >= 0.8), text rows = one rect per text line (IoU >= 0.5)

cloneParity.interpretation: At 1440x900 every one of the 53 sections on the 9 representative routes is at or above the 0.80 gate (minimum 0.9762) and every page average is >= 0.99; two full runs agree within 0.0021 per section. The four weakest sections of 1.1.1 were diagnosed from live / clone / diff images: /404 hero.not-found 0.880 was a harness artefact (the live gradient shapes are script-driven and were not frozen; now pinned symmetrically), / testimonial.client-reflections 0.927 and features.process-timeline 0.945 came from the clone's autoplay starting at mount instead of when the slideshow enters the view (src fix), and / team.founders 0.965 from the missing always-on portrait backdrop (src fix). No parity exception is recorded. Tablet, phone and the remaining 22 routes are in cloneParityRuns.
notMeasured: hover/drag/interaction states (the mobile menu overlay was compared once open at 390 and 768 wide, similarity 0.9999, not a pinned run)
motion timing curves (see recon specs instead)

weakSections.cause: harness artefact (time-dependent shot), not a clone mismatch
weakSections.diagnosis: Layout, text rows and the digit shapes already matched (text rows 64/65 matched at IoU 0.99). The gradient inside the 404 digits is two rotating shapes (14 s and 10 s per turn). In the clone they are CSS animations and were paused at 0 ms; on the live site they are script-driven (no CSS/WAAPI animation) and kept turning, so the two screenshots caught different gradient angles. Angular velocities match (live 25.8 / -36.0 deg/s, clone 25.7 / -36.0), and extrapolating the live angles back to the page time origin lands on the clone start angles (-171 / 0 deg) within 0.3 s, i.e. the same animation.
weakSections.fix: parity_harness.mjs: rotating elements are detected and pinned symmetrically on both sides (rotation pin, step 3b). No src change.

weakSections.cause: real clone behaviour mismatch (autoplay clock) plus a harness-visible consequence
weakSections.diagnosis: The two sides showed different slides. Measured on the original: left at the top for 13 s, the slideshow still shows slide 1 when scrolled to and advances about 10 s after it came into view (it only plays while on screen). The clone started its 10 s timer at page mount, so by the time the section was reached it had already advanced. Text rows, image rects and computed typography were identical.
weakSections.fix: src/components/home/Testimonials.jsx: the 10 s countdown now runs only while the slideshow intersects the viewport and restarts on every change and (re)entry.

weakSections.cause: same autoplay mismatch: its second shot (one viewport down) contains the top of the testimonial slideshow
weakSections.diagnosis: The process list itself matched (first shot 0.996). The second shot at +900 px shows the slideshow heading, portrait and quote; the clone had advanced to another slide. Residual 0.01: sub-pixel text rasterisation of the revealed lines (identical Range rects, 0.1 px apart).
weakSections.fix: same Testimonials.jsx change; no process-timeline change.

weakSections.diagnosis: Live media rects 4 vs clone 2: the original always draws a backdrop over each founder portrait (50% black masked by a bottom-up gradient, black 0% to transparent 50%), in the default and the hover state alike. The clone only showed a flat 50% black layer on hover. Seen as a grey fade at the bottom of both portraits in the live image and absent in the clone image.
weakSections.fix: src/styles/home-sections.css .hs-tc-bd: always on, masked by linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0%, transparent 50%); the hover-only opacity rules were removed.

cloneParityRuns.note: Parity beyond the 9 routes at 1440 (cloneParity). Same harness, same symmetric freeze, same 0.80 per-section gate; every run was made twice and the second run is the pinned repeat. Result files are text-free (scores, geometry); live screenshots are never committed.
cloneParityRuns.liveCounterpart: Every one of the 31 routes in templates/routes.json has a live counterpart: 30 are in the original sitemap and /404 is the original 404 page. There is no route without a live counterpart.
